notes: INFERToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 INFER once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no administrative powers, post-deployment minting, transfer taxes or burn entry points. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the token supply.
